title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 2 Release With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: A major Isekai franchise now streaming with Crunchyroll has finally confirmed the release window for Season 2 with the first trailer showing off the first look at what’s coming next. 2026 has been a strong year for new Isekai anime releases so far , but it’s been even better for fans of longer running franchises too.

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Game's Video Reveals Story, Characters, Classes, Dungeons
content: Nintendo began streaming on Tuesday a Direct livestream for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave , a new game in the Fire Emblem strategy RPG series, and it reveals the story, characters, classes, Free Time activities, and dungeons. The story revolves around the Heroic Games.

title: 27 Years Ago, MTV’s Fan-Favorite, Cult Animated Classic Debuted
content: Platforms like Cartoon Network, Nickelodeon, and Netflix might be the premier spots to check out animation these days, but they weren’t the only kids on the block when it came to producing animated offerings in the past. For some time, Music Television had its fair share of animated series that populated its schedule.

title: Kamome Maruyono's I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san Manga Gets TV Anime
content: TOHO animation announced on Tuesday that Kamome Maruyono 's Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san ( I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san ) manga is receiving a television anime adaptation. Animation Studio Passione is producing the anime.

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2's New Video Unveils More Cast, Opening Song, October Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Firehead and YahaKo 's A Wild Last Boss Appeared! light novel series unveiled on Tuesday the second season anime's first promotional video, seven more cast members, returning and new staff members, and October premiere.
